name: Tesha M. Peeples
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Tesha M. Peeples is an attorney board certified in family law and a shareholder with the Diggs & Sadler law firm in Houston, Texas. A highly compassionate attorney, Ms. Peeples has gained a reputation as a child custody lawyer, and she provides empathetic, understanding counsel to her clients to help them make the best-informed decisions regarding their child custody and support matters as well as all other issues involved with their divorces.

Throughout the course of her legal career, Ms. Peeples has represented many high-profile public figures, professional athletes and others with considerable assets, and she always maintains a strict code of confidentiality that has helped her gain the trust and respect of those she serves. No matter her clients' means or status in society, Ms. Peeples listens intently to fully grasp their needs so that she can deliver the customized strategies and solutions necessary to help them achieve their goals as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible. Ms. Peeples also has jury trial experience and is poised to assist clients in all aspects of their family law litigation.

Recognized for her outstanding professionalism and unwavering commitment to her clients, Ms. Peeples has earned consistent top rankings from her peers. She has also received Superb client ratings on Avvo as well as the site's Clients' Choice Award, and she has received the 10 Best in Client Satisfaction Award from the American Institute of Family Law Attorneys for the past several years. Moreover, she receives many referrals from those she has served, and she finds great reward in being able to help so many in their times of need.

A summa cum laude graduate of the University of Houston-Downtown, Ms. Peeples obtained her Juris Doctor from the University of Houston Law Center in 2010. While there, she served as chief articles editor of the Journal of Consumer and Commercial Law, and she was an active member of the school's moot court team, where she was a champion or finalist in several competitions.
Tesha is board certified in family law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization.

Active in her legal community as well, Ms. Peeples is a member of the State Bar of Texas' Family Law Section, and she has recently concluded serving her second three-year appointment as member of its District 4 grievance committee, and served two terms as the Panel Chair of her committee. She is also a former member of the organization's Unauthorized Practice of Law Committee, and she is a member of the Houston Bar Association's Family Law Section, the Montgomery County Bar Association, the Houston Association of Women Attorneys, as well as past member of the Houston Association of Women Attorneys judicial screening committee. Tesha was recently hand-selected by the Texas Board of Law Examiners to serve on the first ever panel appointed by the Texas Supreme Court to evaluate the minimum passing score for the Texas Bar Exam, a true testament to Tesha's experience and reputation in the legal community.
